title: Finding register file: code
description: One register file docs/findings/register/code/<ID>.json holds a minor finding in code or in text that agents execute. The contract is interface-contracts.md, register file. The schema uses no oneOf, because schema-validate supports none, so finding-lint checks the rules that tie waived to the override keys.

id.description: The ID that next-id printed. The file name is <id>.json.

source.description: The review or session that found the finding.

review_class.description: The class of the register folder.

type.description: A type from the vocabulary of the class.

story.description: The story ID the review ran for, or null when no story exists yet.

finding.description: What is wrong and the fix, as plain text.

in_use.description: true when something outside the current playbook run depends on the artifact. finding-lint checks it against git for code and runtime findings.

harms_downstream.description: true when the finding causes a wrong result, data loss, a security breach, or a broken contract, and the artifact is in use. true only when in_use is true.

fails_purpose.description: true when the reviewed artifact fails the job it exists for.

raises_cost.description: true when the artifact works, but the finding makes later reading, change, or testing harder.

basis.description: The basis of the code class, as docs/spec/schemas/finding-basis.json defines it.

commit.description: The reviewed commit as 40 hexadecimal characters.

override_by.description: Human field. The stakeholder who lowered or waived the finding.

override_reason.description: Human field. Why the stakeholder lowered or waived the finding.
